Announcing the RGL 6s Newcomer Cup with training intensive by TF2 Coaching Central!

RGL, the largest North American competitive TF2 league, is running their next 6s Newcomer Cup September 4-6! In conjunction, TF2 Coaching Central (TF2CC) will run a four week training intensive, where eligible players with no to minimal competitive experience will be put into teams and assigned a coach to teach them the basics of 6s! Coaches will help players learn the maps and strategies while preparing them for their first competitive event. Similarly to TF2CC's previous Newbie Cup events, players will spend the training period scrimming with teammates and reviewing with their coach before facing off in the cup operated by RGL.

Signups for the training intensive are open now at the [url=https://discord.gg/ybSYAd9]TF2CC Discord[/url]! The deadline to apply is August 8, 2026. Players are also welcome to sign up and participate in the RGL cup independently without the training program. TF2 Coaching Central will have coaching, learning resources, and pickup games available to the public.

newsitems.title: The International: Predictions, Fantasy, and Supporter Bundles
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/5c825b3d35627bfc4276c013745aa6fd4de935ea.png[/img]

Nearly a year has passed since Team Falcons hoisted the Aegis of Champions as the final team standing in Hamburg. But that was last year's story, and the time has come to turn our thoughts to Shanghai and the crop of competitors who vie to write the tale of [i]this[/i] year. All of their battles have brought them to the precipice. The International is just two weeks away.

After a decisive month of intense qualifiers, dominant performances from prior champions, and upset victories from up-and-comers, all sixteen teams have earned their invitations to this year's International.

Now it's time for us to extend an invitation to you.

We've just released an update featuring this year's TI-themed activities and item bundles. Not sure what that means? Keep reading for a handy guide to all the different ways to participate so you can find the content that's most interesting to you.

[list][*][b]I want to directly support my favorite teams and personalities.[/b][/list]
With supporter bundles for all sixteen teams and more than a hundred participating event talent, there's never been a better time to support your favorites. In addition to the four primary event languages, this year we're also offering community bundles for WXC Co. (Filipino), NS_ART (Brazilian Portuguese), and Maincast (Ukrainian). 50% of sales from supporter bundles (teams, talent, and community broadcasts) goes directly to the team or talent and 30% goes to the tournament prize pool.

[list][*][b]I want to show off that I supported my favorite team.[/b][/list]
Purchasing team supporter bundles of various levels will grant all kinds of things: custom sprays, a special badge for your health bar, custom team emoticons, custom chat wheel lines, and — new this year as a part of the Gold tier — a global effigy. This new building will replace your regular effigy through the end of September, allowing you to show your team support right in your base. Not supportive enough? You can purchase additional supporter levels that will upgrade the appearance of your effigy, including custom effects.

[list][*][b]I'm right about everything. Help me prove it.[/b][/list]
Predictions are back: How will the Swiss matches shake out? What about the bracket? Fun fact: Exactly zero have ever gotten the full Swiss stage results correct. Will you be the first this year? Not if you don't get your guesses in before the first match starts (10am CST, Thursday 8/13).

[list][*][b]I'm a huge fan of my favorite team but also I dislike all of their choices and wish I was in charge.[/b][/list]
We've got a new take on fantasy this year. We've introduced a new customization point: You. You're the coach, and can now assign custom modifiers to yourself that influence your whole team. We've also updated prefixes, suffixes, and the player drafting rules. You'll draft your perfect team in (mostly) pairs: both supports from one team, the safelaner and offlaner from one team, and then your favorite midlaner. 

[list][*][b]I am a Dota player and I'm already assuming I'll be the best at everything. What do I win?[/b][/list]
Like last year, awards will be granted to participating players based on their performance relative to everyone else. The Tyrian Regalia treasure is making a royal return with five refashioned Immortal items, exclusively available to the top performing players. New this year is the Terrain Token, which will allow winners to choose one of six returning custom terrains, including Reef's Edge and Immortal Gardens. Look for more information, including reward tiers and lots of details, in the Rewards section of the main Dota 2 menu.

[list][*][b]All of this is great but I did my predictions and my fantasy and supported the teams and talent already. What do I do [i]now[/i]?[/b][/list]
Good news for you: We also just shipped a new gameplay patch along with a ton of content fixes. Check out the [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]Summer Scrub 2026[/url] page for more details.

BlackCell daily challenges count toward the three challenges required to earn Daily Challenge Bonus XP.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/711f58cf0c1cfab857dfe03ec37ffe25b2a6bcf1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus:[/b] Players who purchased Season 04 BlackCell and go on to purchase Season 05 BlackCell will activate a permanent 10% XP and Weapon XP bonus in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] (40% bonus for purchasing BlackCell in Seasons 01, 02, 03, 04, and 05 and up to a 50% bonus for purchasing BlackCell in every [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] season!).[/p][p][/p][h2]Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock the Spectre Operator[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2335660b73f8a76078d746609a7d43fc979c27e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Players who purchase the premium Season 05 Battle Pass or BlackCell gain full access to the Battle Pass Instant Rewards Page, unlocking the following items:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]10% Battle Pass XP Boost[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The new “Spectre” Operator plus a BlackCell variant for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Dawn Shred” Legendary Blueprint for the Voyak KT-3 Assault Rifle[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Swift Talent” Emote[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Make an Entrance” Animated Calling Card[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]The Season 05 Battle Pass features 100+ pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new (and free) Base Weapons. In every case, Spectre’s victims have been slain with surgically precise mid-line stab wounds with rarely any signs of struggle.[/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Battle Pass Operator Skins[/h2][p][/p][p]Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock multiple Operator Skins, many paired with BlackCell variants, including the following:[/p][p][/p][h3]T.E.D.D.: “General Chaos” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 2[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0bbfa389dfe78ccb780cd62546e4a7a4fb2f8b88.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Bring a new level of chaos to your skirmishes as T.E.D.D. swaps out a clean head for a nightmare-inducing skull stitched together with staples and wiring over bloodstained black armor. From the looks of his grease-stained shirt and overalls and the heavy chains at his back, he’s already been hard at work toughening up for the next season of combat.[/p][p][/p][h3]Anderson: “In Flight” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 5[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/af7aca45a11e861d5602a80c514d938d74ab505d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Dempsey: “Corrosive Fury” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 7[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8a7d5ec341d3578fc3ab2b84bb53198335e00eeb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Combining heavy armor with a strong dose of intimidation, Dempsey wears a spiked helmet, pauldrons, and red body armor, all scratched up and smeared with the blood of his enemies. The BlackCell variant opts for a polished black and gold design, no less intimidating for its striking sheen.[/p][p][/p][h3]Vermaak: “Heavy Engineer” Skin[/h3][p][i]Operator Skin, Battle Pass Page 9[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b285ab9ec572e0ef218265aaad340dccebeb94a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]No skirmish is too hot for Vermaak as the Operator prepares to withstand the most punishing damage with a full complement of heavy armor pieces, a helmet and gas mask, and tools to surpass any obstacle in his way.[/p][p][/p][h3]Grimm: “Cobalt Guard” Skin[/h3][p][i]Operator Skin, Battle Pass Page 10[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/57d4950793269f93d11202e5030e4bb3df3af721.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Favoring the latest in combat technology, Grimm combines mobility and defense with full body armor including augmented leg support to support long distance travel with minimal wear and tear.[/p][p][/p][h3]Richtofen: “Fester” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 11[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/95d93626ba5494cdcf2ff46f0c7f3a7f7af60de3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Richtofen has seen better days; his body emaciated and infused with deadly steel, wielding a spiked collar at his neck and a mechanical arm with sharpened claws. The BlackCell variant changes the camouflage design for a more modern, high-tech look.[/p][p][/p][h3]Wei Lin: “Beast Mechanic” Skin[/h3][p][i]Operator Skin, Battle Pass Page 15[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/79ecb6885b879bbdc7583dec2d746786190158f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Wei Lin moves from the garage to the field of battle, wearing a backwards cap and overalls with a tool belt at her waist filled with the essentials needed to breach any obstacle.[/p][p][/p][h2]Season 05: Battle Pass: Free Base Weapons[/h2][p][/p][p]Head into combat with renewed confidence wielding the FG42 Assault Rifle, instantly recognizable by its side-mounted magazine, as well as the dual-wield Gremlin SMG. Unlock these two new free Base Weapons in the Season 05 Battle Pass.[/p][p][/p][p]All players can unlock these weapons for free by progressing through their listed Battle Pass Pages.[/p][p][/p][h3]Primary Weapon: FG42 (Launch)[/h3][p][i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Page 3 HVT, Page 15 HVT Battle Pass and BlackCell Blueprint[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4c655c8c662f165554fbe93a217792e85fe2e057.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Levels: 37[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 3[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints, Camos and Reticle Unlocks (END, MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p][/p][p][i]Full-auto assault rifle. Well-rounded with average accuracy, mobility, and power.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The FG42 Assault Rifle offers a reliable attacking option across a variety of combat situations, its jack-of-all-trades stats forgoing flair and glaring weaknesses for a steady platform. The weapon’s low recoil and rapid recentering speed allow constant fire even on distant targets, allowing Operators to competitively engage the enemy even down long sightlines, making the FG42 an excellent choice across all game modes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige Attachment — MFS Ambilateral Stock:[/b] [i]Additional weight from this stock greatly improves an Operator’s recoil control at the expense of handling and mobility.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Primary Weapon: Gremlin (Launch)[/h3][p][i]SMG, Battle Pass Page 6 HVT, Page 12 HVT Tier Battle Pass and BlackCell Blueprint[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e6b5c3590fb8ad194fd848e86b004e97ef3a67a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Levels: 47[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 4[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 26[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments:[/b] Muzzle, Barrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints, Camo Unlocks (END, MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p][/p][p][i]Full-auto submachine gun. Finish the Completion Page to acquire the following:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]“Viscera” Ultra Skin for Spectre plus a BlackCell variant for those who purchase BlackCell [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fission Core” Legendary Carbon 57 SMG Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]200 COD Points [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Thousand Cuts” Animated Calling Card [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Strive” Animated Emblem [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Gift Card” Ultra GobbleGum (x1)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Spectre: “Viscera” BlackCell Variant Operator Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Premium Battle Pass and BlackCell, Completion Page[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e055432d22c014b47504c066adab19c23188b719.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Spectre prepares to face off against threats with a highly mobile and armored getup. The BlackCell variant ups the style with gold accents, a swirling armor pattern, and red lights indicating that trouble’s coming for anyone who dares stand in Spectre’s way.[/p][p][/p][h2]Store Highlights: New Ultra Skins, Reactive, and Mastercraft Bundles[/h2][p][/p][p]Return to the Store throughout Season 05 for new Bundles featuring a variety of themed content including new Mastercraft Weapon Blueprints, Reactive Weapon Blueprints, Ultra Skins, and more.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Mastercraft[/b] Weapon Blueprints include custom animations, unique weapon inspections, and more. Players can change the Barrel, Stock, and other attachments while maintaining the weapon’s signature look.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reactive[/b] Weapon Blueprints feature a visual effect that intensifies as you eliminate enemies. Reactive Weapon Blueprints also maintain their signature look when changing the Barrel, Stock, and other attachments.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Ultra Skins[/b] are highly detailed, themed, and may include VFX. Some Ultra Skins are also Reactive Skins.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Season 05 Store highlights include:[/p][p][/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Sand Sovereign Bundle[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/636f145cd021825b2f9376d07cac8ebd5021f975.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Master the shifting sands and journey beyond the horizon, thriving where others are lost. Excel in the most unforgiving terrain with a new Kagan Operator Skin and cut through the heat haze with two sand-blasted Weapon Blueprints, paired with an Emote, compass-themed Weapon Charm, and more. The full Bundle offering includes:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]“Mirage” Kagan Operator Skin (Guild)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Sandstorm” VST SMG Blueprint (Tracers)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Desert Piercer” Strider 300 Sniper Rifle Blueprint (Tracers)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Seen Enough” Emote[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“True Way” Animated Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Swarmed” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Sand Marauder” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1-Hour Double XP Token[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Sentry’s Watch Mastercraft Ultra Skin Bundle[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2f4741fb7da5192ed2e04dd7f1078783990b2c9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Protect the realm from every threat with the finest forged tools available, starting with the highly disciplined Wei Li Operator Skin paired with a Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint transforming the new Season 05 Mammoth LMG into a sight to behold with crossbow-like limbs and strings attached to the barrel. Wield the power of the dragon with these and the following Bundle items:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]“Youxia” Wei Lin Operator Skin (JSOC)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Arcforge” Mammoth LMG Blueprint (New Weapon, Mastercraft, Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Blue Dragon” VST SMG Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dragon’s Signal” Emote[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Cumulus” Reticle[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Big Bad Ballista” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dragon Lord” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Eternal Warrior” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1-Hour Double Weapon XP Token[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Un-Synced Mastercraft Ultra Skin Bundle[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f0cde6d25e7651462aa6d5fd5f18c763b03d2ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Rip the universe into pieces with this Bundle featuring an Operator Skin with three interchangeable head options: deploy with a neon green, translucent skull in a shattered helmet, an enclosed helmet and visor, or with the helmet off to enter combat face to face with your foes. In addition, get a Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint for the new Season 05 FG42 Assault Rifle plus two other Weapon Blueprints, a Finishing Move, Emote, and more. The full Bundle contents include:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]“Phasetorn” Vermaak Operator Skin with three head variants (JSOC)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Resync” FG42 Assault Rifle Blueprint (New Weapon, Mastercraft, Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Shatter Lock” Sturmwolf 45 SMG Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“No Return” Velox 5.7 Pistol (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Back Drop” Finishing Move[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Mental Break” Emote[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Trifecta” Reticle[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Unleashed Potential” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“To Pieces” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1-Hour Double Weapon XP Token[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Combat Cabinet Reactive Ultra Skin Bundle[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4f9cb22b21c8384ffd95e90ba65fdd750bc6d3c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Break records and achieve the high score with this arcade-themed Bundle headlined by a walking arcade cabinet, two video game-inspired Weapon Blueprints, and a Finishing Move that crushes opponents with the Arcade Classics. For showing off your love of old school gaming, nothing else compares. Get the Bundle to access the following items:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]“Max Score” Reaper EWR-3 Operator Skin (Guild)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Player One” VS Recon Sniper Rifle Blueprint (Reactive, Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Player Two” Voyak KT-3 Assault Rifle Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Arcade Rumble” Finishing Move[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Shmup” Reticle[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Coveted Arsenal” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“You Died” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Final Boss” Animated Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Skill Set” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Wild Drip Bundle[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/036db74aed99cdbc4de2418626618f24627454d4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Keep your style untamed and your vibes immaculate with the Wild Drip Bundle, headlined by a Takeo Operator Skin with impeccable taste and two tagged up, samurai-themed Weapon Blueprints, a kingly Emote, and more items claiming unprecedented drip. Get the Bundle for the following items:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]“Untamed” Takeo Operator Skin (JSOC)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Samurai Tango” CBRS-3 SMG Blueprint (Tracers)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Ronin Wrecker” XM325 LMG Blueprint (Tracers)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“From the Top” Emote[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Spin Out” Reticle[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Modern Oni” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Downtown Racer” Loading Screen[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“On the House” Legendary GobbleGum (x1)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Shadow Wolf Bundle[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f49a08887347e081bf46aa1f025b2dcc830136a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Control the fight with masterful tactical decisions while deploying with a Mil-Sim Harper Operator Skin and two scrappy Weapon Blueprints that have survived countless scrapes with the enemy. Set the example of how to enforce the law with the full Bundle offering including the following items:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]“Earned Patch” Harper Operator Skin (JSOC)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fang Tactics” EGRT-17 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Damage Control” M10 Breacher Shotgun Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Lead Bite” Finishing Move[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Blind Rage” Flashbang Equipment Skin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Memento” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Renegade” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Pre-Order Bonus Camo[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9c7177ccbff15d76c3adf073e8da7a0e33b90b62.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Players who pre-order or pre-purchase either of the Digital Editions of [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] (Standard or Vault Edition) will receive the Gilded Pearl Weapon Camo Pack in [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. The Pack consists of:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The Moonlit Pearl Universal Camo in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], which also unlocks instantly in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Gilded Pearl Camo Pack Challenge in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], going live on July 23 at 12PM PT.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Complete the Gilded Pearl Camo Pack Challenge to unlock the following:[/p][list][*][p]The Gilded Ruin Universal Camo in [i]Black Ops 7[/i], which also unlocks instantly in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you are one of the first 100,000 players to complete the Gilded Pearl Camo Pack Challenge, the Gilded Ruin Universal Camo you unlock also comes engraved with a unique, first-of-its-kind serialized number displayed on ranged weapons equipped with the camo.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]The Challenge requires players to earn 5,000 Skull Score in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] by eliminating enemies across Endgame, Multiplayer, Zombies, and/or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Enemies have a different criteria and Skull Score depending on the mode you are playing:[/p][list][*][p][b]Endgame:[/b] Defeat enemies. 5 Skull Score per elimination. 1,000 eliminations needed. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Defeat other players: 10 Skull Score per elimination. 500 eliminations needed. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Zombies:[/b] Defeat enemies: 1 Skull Score per elimination. 5,000 eliminations needed. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Call of Duty: Warzone:[/b] Defeat other players: 30 Skull Score per elimination. 167 eliminations needed. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]The faster you complete the Challenge, the lower the serialization number will be. Players who complete the Challenge after all Serialized Camos are awarded will still earn the second Camo without the serialization.[/p][p][/p][h2]Verify Your Email and Unlock Double XP Tokens, Weapon Camo [/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8c35856ead127b7c829ee8a7858c35a65013f5a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t done so already, unlock a wealth of Double XP and the Universal Weapon Camo “Veiled Aurora” simply by verifying your email. Verifying your Call of Duty account email helps strengthen security. Once you complete this verification, expect the following to be added to your Call of Duty Account:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]1-Hour 2XP Level Tokens (x5)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1-Hour 2XP Weapon Tokens (x5)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1-Hour 2XP Battle Pass Tokens (x5)[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p]For those who have previously verified, rewards will have been automatically added to your inventory. [/p][p] [/p][p]For more info on email verification, visit our Activision Account Email Verification FAQ [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/activision-account-email-verification"]here[/url]. You can also [url="https://www.callofduty.com/verify-email"]click here to easily verify your email[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 7 Today![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c1809deeb40881027b5150d9bd406757a291e3b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com/blackops7"]Purchase Black Ops 7 today[/url] to access the entirety of the Season 04 Call of Duty experience, including Multiplayer and Zombies in addition to the free-to-play Call of Duty: Warzone.[/p][p][/p][p][i]©/TM/2026 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4: Open Beta, NEXT, Fanatics Fest, & Serialized Camo
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c04733b5794c2a64b580ccc45a9bd790be0d8c8b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Fanatics Fest Recap: Modern Warfare 4 Brings Kill Block to Fanatics Fest[/h2][p][/p][p]New York fans came ready to play. [/p][p][/p][p]Over four packed days at Fanatics Fest, [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] turned its show-floor presence into a full-scale destination, giving fans their first hands-on experience with [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer through Kill Block while offering a deeper look at the game's Multiplayer experience and how Call of Duty continues to bring competition, spectacle, and culture together.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="j_F2jgnQVcE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]First Deployments into Kill Block[/h3][p]Kill Block was the center of gravity. Set within the West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility, the new Multiplayer experience made its public debut with fast, aggressive 10v10 Gunfight matches, giving players a first taste of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]’s adaptive live-fire training environment. Designed for fast-paced, close-quarters combat, Kill Block's ever-changing battleground rewarded repeat play, encouraging players to rethink their tactics from one match to the next, and drew crowds throughout the weekend.[/p][p][/p][h3]From the Booth: The Modern Warfare 4 Experience[/h3][p]The experience extended well beyond the gameplay stations. Infinity Ward developers were also on hand throughout the weekend, meeting players, answering questions, and offering deeper insight into [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]'s evolving Multiplayer experience through live discussions and a special live episode of the COD POD. The MW4 booth buzzed with activity as creators streamed live, athletes and special guests stepped into exhibition Grudge Matches, and fans explored interactive displays and took on the Polaris Path to Victory by navigating rugged terrain in a specially themed off-road experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a405fcfa3a0a7774ad796a3b1843c4806cd7a822.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Making its public debut at Fanatics Fest, the Aston Martin Dreadnought concept vehicle was unveiled and gave attendees their first look at the bespoke tactical SUV created through the collaboration between Aston Martin and Infinity Ward. Later this year, players will move from admiring it on the show floor to driving it across the battlefields of the next chapter of [i]Modern Warfare® 4[/i]'s DMZ and [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3]Call of Duty in Culture[/h3][p][/p][p]Beyond the gameplay, the "Call of Duty in Culture" panel brought together Mark Grigsby, Co-Studio Head at Infinity Ward, Tyler Bahl, Chief Marketing Officer at Activision, and guests from across sports, entertainment, and media to discuss how [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] continues [i]Call of Duty[/i]'s connection to competition, community, and modern culture.[/p][p][/p][p]Collectors also had their own objectives to chase. Inside the Armory, limited-edition MW4 merchandise, Ghostwrite collectible figures, Ghost mask balaclavas, MW4 Beta code opportunities, and event rewards gave fans plenty to earn, redeem, and take home. Fans left with MW4 keepsakes to commemorate their first hands-on experience with [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3c58ecc6c042c52b895239cd2783e017e62569ae.jpg"][/img][/p][p]From the first deployment into Kill Block to the unveiling of the Aston Martin Dreadnought, Fanatics Fest gave players their first hands-on experience with [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] and an early look at what's still to come. [/p][p][/p][p]Now the spotlight turns to Call of Duty®: NEXT.[/p][p][/p][h2]Intel Incoming: Call of Duty: NEXT and Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta dates Revealed[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2f7b99356c12174d8494b9f6d8f7384a83415401.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The next major [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] moment arrives on August 21.[/p][p][/p][p]Tune in to Call of Duty: NEXT on this date for a global event featuring live gameplay, an in-depth briefing on the lineup of content coming to [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]'s Multiplayer, developer insights, and new reveals ahead of the Beta.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0281dc899595081d877f88ff00816990453b4daf.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Beta*: Times for Weekend One and Two[/h3][p]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta begins on August 21, kicking off immediately after the Call of Duty: NEXT broadcast for the first time ever. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dc5e698d79769c699db33af130fbc8711480db66.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Weekend One (Modern Warfare 4 Early Access Beta):[/b] This begins on August 21 and ends on August 25. The Early Access Beta is available to players who have pre-ordered the game on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weekend Two (Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta):[/b] The second Beta weekend is open to all players on all platforms, regardless of their pre-order status. The second [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta weekend is scheduled to begin on August 28 and end on September 1.[/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Content Overview[/h3][p]Get ready to drop into multiple Multiplayer maps and modes, choosing from a wide selection of brand-new Operators, including all the Vault Edition Operators for players who pre-order the Vault Edition, and unlocking as many as 19 different weapons before deploying into everything from small-scale 3v3 skirmishes to massive tactical battles featuring tanks and more. Test your mettle across new and returning modes, from Search & Destroy to the brand-new Kill Block, plus the Training Mobility Course.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/915fde1131360e8cd3ae2ae2b51d896a7dd9799a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Experience fluid movement and best-in-class ballistics, building your own loadouts with the optional help of Gunny, leveling up as you unlock a wide variety of weapons, Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades, Perks, and Killstreaks.[/p][p][/p][p]And that’s just scratching the surface… expect more gameplay intel soon![/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition: Gear Up for the Beta[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/381cdc27c05d5a93e83376c2a1b742a07de5ab03.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Hostile Alliance Operator Pack Benefits:[/b] If you’ve pre-ordered the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition, you can play the Multiplayer portion of the Beta as any of the four Operators from the Hostile Alliance Operator Pack:[/p][list][*][p]Price[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Valeria[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ghost[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Blix[/p][/*][/list][p]Note: Price and Valeria can be masked or unmasked, accessible via the emote system.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/270cac7988aa7cc0181b9d656165f9ed36bc2965.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Special Forces Operator Pack Benefits:[/b] Those with a Vault Edition pre-order can also access all four Operators from the Special Forces Operator Pack:[/p][list][*][p]COM SFT (France)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]KSK Amphibious (Germany)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]SK Special Forces (South Korea)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]SAS (United Kingdom)[/p][/*][/list][p]Note: Each of these Operators has a Voice Pack in their local language.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6051653ca2e35214e018fe3058acbd46f159911f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Signature Weapons Collection Benefits:[/b] In addition, Vault Edition pre-order players can immediately test out the base weapon and Blueprint from any of the five armaments in the Signature Weapon Collection, along with its Apex Attachment:[/p][list][*][p]Kastov 762 Assault Rifle and “Voltspine” Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]ISO Nightshade Submachine Gun and “La Sombra Venenosa” (“The Poisonous Shadow”) Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Rezi 12 Shotgun and “Shattered Code” Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Oris 8.6 Marksman Rifle and “Volt-Edge” Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Combat Knife (Melee) and “Sombra Besada” (“Shadow’s Kiss”) Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][p]More details on this unprecedented Beta experience, including exclusive Beta rewards and other surprises, are to be expected in the weeks to come.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta occurs across two weekends and will feature Early Access days as well as an Open Beta period. Internet access is required for participation.[/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Pre-Order Bonus Serialized Camo Intel[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5fca18ff82ecaba74faeb649e9d68fda1817795.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ready to make your mark when [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i] Season 05 launches on July 23? Unlock the “Moonlit Pearl” Universal Weapon Camo instantly, then complete a special Challenge in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] to earn a second Universal Weapon Camo (named “Gilded Ruin”), with a uniquely serialized variant of this second Weapon Camo, individually numbered for the first 100,000 players to unlock it. Then instantly unlock both rewards in [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i]. Read on for the full intel.[/p][p][/p][h3]1. How do you acquire the Gilded Pearl Weapon Camo Pack?[/h3][p][/p][p]Prior to July 23 and the launch of Season 05, digitally pre-order or pre-purchase [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] in either Standard or Vault Edition format. Players who pre-order, or who have already pre-ordered [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], will instantly receive the Gilded Pearl Camo Pack. The Moonlit Pearl Universal Camo unlocks immediately, along with a Challenge that becomes available near the start of Season 05, allowing you to earn the Gilded Ruin Universal Camo. The challenge to unlock the Gilded Ruin Weapon Camo will begin on July 23 at 12PM PT.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: You can pre-order [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] after July 23, but your chances of unlocking the serialized Weapon Camo are greatly diminished, due to the time-sensitive nature of the Challenge. [/p][p][/p][h3]2. How do you complete the Gilded Pearl Camo Pack Challenge?[/h3][p][/p][p]As [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Season 05 begins, those players who pre-ordered [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] digitally should expect to find the Moonlit Pearl Universal Camo in your Gunsmith Camos Menu along with all your other unlocked camos. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/131ae28632f47ae09fd3a901b1b93dc349c231c1.jpg"][/img][i]The Moonlit Pearl Universal Camo (top) and Gilded Ruin Camo (bottom).[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The Challenge is separate, with the following stipulations: [/p][list][*][p]You are here to earn a second Universal Camo: the Gilded Ruin.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The first 100,000 players that complete the Challenge will receive a special version of the Camo that features their unique Serialization number between 1-100,000 engraved into the surface of the Gilded Ruin Camo. A non-engraved version is also awarded.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The faster you complete the challenge, the lower your unique Serialization number will be. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Players who complete the Challenge after all 100,000 serialized Gilded Ruin Camo variants have been awarded still unlock the standard Gilded Ruin Universal Camo without serialization engravement.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f928a7953dc3bc1af4021613387698e5ef7fa55.jpg"][/img][i]The Gilded Ruin Camo with a unique serialized number engraved on it.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Preload the Season 5 update and be ready to hop in on July 23 at 12PM PT if you’re aiming for a lower Serialization number![/p][p][/p][h3]3. What are the steps to complete the Gilded Pearl Camo Pack Challenge? [/h3][p][/p][p]The Challenge is as follows: Earn 5,000 Skulls in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] by eliminating enemies across Endgame, Multiplayer, Zombies and/or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i]. Each mode awards a different number of Skulls per Elimination:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Endgame:[/b] Defeat enemies: 5 Skulls per Elimination. [/p][p][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Defeat other players: 10 Skulls per Elimination. [/p][p][b]Zombies:[/b] Defeat enemies: 1 Skull per Elimination. [/p][p][b]Call of Duty: Warzone™:[/b] Defeat other players: 30 Skulls per Elimination. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] You can optionally swap between modes during the Challenge and keep your current Skull Score, as there is only one Skull Score track no matter which mode you choose.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note: [/b]Both the Moonlit Pearl and Gilded Ruin Camos can be placed on any [i]Black Ops 7[/i] weapon (once you complete the Challenge), as well as any [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] weapon (at launch).[/p][p][/p][p]Reach the 5,000 Skull Score target, claim the Gilded Ruin Universal Camo, and if you’re impressive enough, secure your place in [i]Call of Duty[/i] history before all the unique serialization numbers are gone!  [/p][p][/p][h3]4. Are the Camos Also Available in Modern Warfare 4? [/h3][p][/p][p]Yes.  [/p][p][/p][p]Once you’ve completed the Challenge in [i]Black Ops 7[/i], you can proudly display both the Moonlit Pearl and the Gilded Ruin Camos on any weapon you choose, along with the unique serialization number if you’ve completed the Challenge in time.[/p][p]  [/p][p]Then, on October 23, you can showcase any [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] weapon in either camo, as both will unlock instantly. [/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae715cd91fef1c84700767dda0cd54c3ab6b0cbc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay tuned to the Call of Duty Blog for the latest official intel as we move toward additional information drops before the Modern Warfare 4 launch on October 23.[/p][p][/p][p]Preorders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [url="https://CallofDuty.com"]CallofDuty.com[/url]. For more information on preordering, including Vault Edition content, rewards, and a special Loyalty Discount, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"]see the Pre-order blog here[/url].  [/p][p][/p][p]Stay Frosty. [/p][p][/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026. [/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Steam. [/p][p][/p][p]Additional development by  — in alphabetical order — Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch. [/p][p][/p][p][i]*Actual launch date(s), times, and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. See www.callofduty.com/beta for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required. Online multiplayer subscription may be required for MP Beta.[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: Call of Duty® and Aston Martin Unveil the Dreadnought for Modern Warfare® 4
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d1f4a12856e4f1b5640b9d0d42502e8a9625204.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Introducing the Dreadnought[/h3][p][/p][p]Every so often a vehicle drops into [i]Call of Duty[/i] that stands apart from the rest. Today, [i]Call of Duty[/i] and Aston Martin are proud to reveal that vehicle, the Aston Martin Dreadnought, an in-game, bespoke tactical SUV concept created for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]™. Developed through a collaboration between Aston Martin’s design team and engineered from the ground up with Infinity Ward, the Dreadnought reimagines what happens when one of the world’s most iconic ultra-luxury performance brands enters the world of [i]Modern Warfare[/i]. This is one of the most aggressive all-wheel drive machines in the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db29101b300d40b76b2dbf2001a58ffac57fd523.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]When Luxury Meets Tactical Performance[/h3][p][/p][p]Designed by the same Aston Martin team responsible for some of the marque’s most celebrated vehicles, the Dreadnought is an exploration of what’s possible when designers are freed from real-world constraints.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ef000566858cba7d55f21a55688323cfaa8fa34b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Drive to survive[/h3][p][/p][p]The Dreadnought rolls with an armored exterior and military-grade armor plating. This isn't a joyride SUV that folds under the first burst of fire. It's a mobile fortress. Push objectives and drive straight through contested ground while its impressive armor plating helps absorb the heaviest of incoming fire.[/p][p][/p][h3]The most aggressive AWD in MW4[/h3][p][/p][p]Grounded in Modern Warfare's in-game physics and packing supercar-level performance, the Dreadnought is the most aggressive all-wheel drive in the game. This translates to brutal traction, real speed, and the momentum to ram, escape, or run down a squad that thought it had you cornered — all announced by the roar of a full-blooded V12 engine.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fed0500b10b280a29ebf4b328bcc7e2acb7bbf56.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/02706d0bd289bc2ff97377783b2781809f73f0d7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fcf2aad1e915fc34161f0490f3330407e71b0ba3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e9b2715ab0ca26119c8e8837e3cc5f6646d7252c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/511329bb9d1eeb66a444f3fd139c42f51fd3d9b8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a5b5bd2a0fb58e6720b4d0ca2d6fb857a767673e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9d9348360fb59057ecc686db3bd1b3c10d7c3350.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/04ed158bfe8421422ac4a537cb57a4ce63b9444f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b1a0edb3a5addbb10f1c7460b85c6b8cb1edc095.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Aston Martin Dreadnought concept photography shown.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]A Closer Look at the Aston Martin Dreadnought[/h3][p][/p][p]The capabilities of a performance SUV have been translated into an immersive virtual world for the next generation of Aston Martin fans. Grounded in the in-game physics of the [i]Call of Duty[/i] universe, this unapologetic, uncompromising tactical all-wheel drive SUV delivers not only a stunning exploration of extreme visual language, but also an engaging and dynamic player experience. [/p][p][/p][p]The Dreadnought name naturally conjures up images of military might. Aside from its obvious dictionary definition, “fear nothing”, it also recalls the famous early 20th Century British warship, [i]HMS Dreadnought[/i], which was so revolutionary in terms of her armament and propulsion that she coined an entirely new class of warship, defining global naval military ambition in the early 1900s.  The Dreadnought combines supercar levels of performance, advanced armor technologies, and adaptive combat zone intelligence systems into a single, striking form. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/554282834cd87a056a675fa5dcc4108180836be4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Though these elements are purely cosmetic in the game, all have been imagined for elite tactical performance: from its optimized aerodynamics to its fully integrated digital command interfaces. Exquisite design details emphasize the Dreadnought’s high luxury heritage: from the herringbone weave of the exterior carbon fiber to the Oxford Tan leather dashboard and door panel details, and the metallic gold gear lever. These are uniquely contrasted in this digital creation with features rarely found in an Aston Martin like military grade armor plating. [/p][p][/p][h3]Amplified without restraint: Unmistakably Aston Martin[/h3][p][/p][p]Commenting on the debut of the Dreadnought in [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i], Aston Martin Chief Creative Officer, Marek Reichman, said: “The team have hugely enjoyed the not inconsiderable challenge of redefining what an Aston Martin can be when the only limit is imagination. [/p][p][/p][p]“To create the ultimate exotic off-road machine, I had to imagine Dreadnought not only as a digital asset, but as a vehicle living in the real world — navigating the streets of New York, powering through the monsoon-soaked roads of Mumbai, and performing with complete authenticity in every environment,” Reichman said. “That vision allowed us to create something that feels genuinely real, even within the immersive world of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3fb3623736367c301aed57b993a1a04d64dda0df.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1bba46c88ba10814787b71bdc3824e47e5f7adca.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/33a20fe66bc458cad3b0b363d621ae131b31f1cb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bcb1480136477b2bd5e31d659aac8da23febb992.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e07e364958a4fb1c3b92f05ee6500ed5bd99d21e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8e9465282337d4a9020913f191e4447955089ca.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d8543c5f09ae1a0c38b38a4c1d701348846fa25.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2f07051cf9429ceb11c32e882dccc752dc038d82.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a8266a71ca3eb55b989eca15ec3d1c3a84f85971.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/44ab3513f706e1f4328a10b3beee35f1b1d2ee7c.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Aston Martin Dreadnought in-game imagery shown.

[/i]“To me, Dreadnought is unmistakably an Aston Martin — amplified without restraint. The quality of the details we have been able to include, right down to the iconic Chiltern Green paint color so synonymous with this marque, underscores our dedication to delivering a truly authentic Aston Martin experience,” Reichman said. “Features as diverse as the carbon fiber chassis right through to exquisite elements such as the door hinges in anodized Satin Gold, reflect our real-world determination to be the most desirable ultra-luxury brand in the automotive sector, and beyond.”[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d72106a962457c99f954e40f385a6ecdd6151704.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Built Together with Infinity Ward[/h3][p][/p][p]Bringing the Dreadnought to life required close collaboration between Aston Martin and Infinity Ward throughout every stage of development, from concepting and vehicle geometry to animation, in-game physics, propulsion, and gameplay tuning. Every element was engineered to reflect Aston Martin's distinctive design philosophy while delivering a high-performance armored vehicle purpose-built for Modern Warfare 4. The results, explains a member of Infinity Ward’s design team, is “a high performance armored vehicle that stays true to Aston Martin’s distinctive design philosophy and dominates any battleground. This is the most aggressive all-wheel drive vehicle in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].” [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/33a20fe66bc458cad3b0b363d621ae131b31f1cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]See It First at Fanatics Fest NYC, Drive it in game on October 23[/h3][p][/p][p]Fans attending Fanatics Fest NYC will have the opportunity to see a full-size physical interpretation of the Dreadnought before it arrives in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]At launch players can locate the Dreadnought within a few key points of interest across both [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] DMZ and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i].[/p]

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer: Kill Block Intel
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c79f93ed48a51ad0de555cf3aa5cde247c52d04d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Kill Block: A First Look (at Fanatics Fest)
[/h2][p][i]Kill Block Explained
[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY: [/b]Fanatics Fest attendees are among the first members of the public experiencing Kill Block. Here's a closer look at the adaptive Multiplayer battleground and how it fits into Modern Warfare 4's broader Multiplayer offering.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="SJt5bbgQ-TQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Fanatics Fest NYC takes place July 16–19 at New York City's Javits Center, and attendees are the first members of the public to experience Kill Block, one of Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4's new Multiplayer experiences. As players battle across the adaptive training facility throughout the event, we're taking a deeper look at the mode itself, from its modular battleground design and military engineering to its expanded Gunfight experiences and the future of the facility within Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer.[/p][p][/p][p]Read on, and we'll cover the following:[/p][p][/p][h3]Blog Summary[/h3][p][/p][p][b]What is Kill Block?[/b] Learn about the West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility, an adaptive live-fire environment where modular battlegrounds reconfigure before every match, creating hundreds of unique combat configurations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How Kill Block Works:[/b] Go behind the scenes at the facility to discover how the facility's massive modular Slabs move into place, how configurations are assembled, and what tactical opportunities each environment provides.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Safety Off Beyond This Point:[/b] Get the tactical rundown on battles within Kill Block matches, including 3v3 Gunfight and the all-new Gunfight 10v10 modes, and a look at how the facility is being built to support additional core Multiplayer modes after launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's take a closer look at Kill Block...[/p][p][/p][h2]So What Exactly is Kill Block?[/h2][p][i]An Adaptive Live-Fire Training Environment
[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Kill Block is a modular Multiplayer battleground that reconfigures every match, challenging players to rethink routes, sightlines, and combat spaces on the fly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae715cd91fef1c84700767dda0cd54c3ab6b0cbc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to the West Bridge Advanced Military Training — codenamed Kill Block — an off-the-books facility specializing in modular Multiplayer battlegrounds centered on reconfiguring combat layouts. Designed as a live-fire training environment, Kill Block maps reconfigure between matches, forcing players to reassess sightlines, routes, and combat spaces.[/p][p][/p][p]At its core, Kill Block is assembled from three modular sections — two outer areas (“End Slabs”) and one central combat space (“Central Slab”) — that combine into a new combat configuration after each match called a “Combo”. Each section and how they are positioned allows for multiple possible Combo variants, creating hundreds of unique layout combinations that reshape combat flow.[/p][p][/p][p]Most map sections are entirely new, while others draw inspiration from iconic locations across Modern Warfare history. At launch on October 23, more than 500 configurations are possible, with layouts reconfiguring between matches and throughout Gunfight rounds to transform sightlines, routes, cover placement, and engagement pacing.[/p][p][/p][p]Kill Block supports expanded Gunfight experiences, including 3v3 and the new Gunfight 10v10 mode at launch, with future support planned for more core Multiplayer modes.[/p][p][/p][p]Kill Block: Learn the layout. Adapt when it changes.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s take a closer look at the West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility:[/p][p][/p][h2]How Kill Block Works: Engineering Overview[/h2][p][i]Modular Combat Systems
[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Discover how West Bridge's massive towers, motors, rails, and modular Slabs work together to physically reconfigure the combat space between matches.
[/p][/*][/list][p]An impressive feat of military engineering, this self-contained compound features a perimeter of eight massive concrete towers that house an array of electronics, motors, and pulley systems. These are attached to three massive steel-reinforced Slabs that sit within the facility's perimeter, each resting on a network of rail-mounted wheel assemblies known as bogies that travel along tracks embedded above and below the training area.[/p][p][/p][p]When a change of map occurs between matches, the active Slab decouples from the others and is slowly lowered by electric motors into a dedicated storage chamber beneath the arena. A synchronized motor array then switches the rail network to a different Slab, which is winched into position and locked in place, transforming the combat space for the next exercise.[/p][p][/p][p]The result is an ever-changing Combo map that enables Tier One Operator teams to experience a variety of Shoothouse-style environments across numerous combat scenarios.[/p][p][/p][h3]What are Kill Block Combos and Slabs?[/h3][p]Slabs are sectional environments constructed specifically for military training purposes, and there are three linked together in every Kill Block match. Mocked up streets, compounds, and urban blocks provide faithful facsimiles of real-world environments, with many assembled from shipping containers, timber-framed structures, temporary facades, and training props. This is a full-scale tactical set, each built to evoke the character of an operational environment with recognizable spaces, and constructed with a variety of scenery, vantage points, verticality, chokepoints, routes, low openings, and sightlines that typically extend across to an adjacent Slab, and occasionally across the entire map. Three of these Slabs fitted together form a Combo, which is the entire map a match takes place on.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9273f0d3f193026659604d3de9431584b31c036c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/57ead1159e1763ebc99ded75773bd005b5362c48.jpg"][/img][i]Two Kill Block Combos, one completely different match: Note the \[Station], \[Shoot House], and \[Woods] Slabs (first image) and the \[Killhouse]], \[Ambush], and \[Snow Block] Slabs (second image), slotting together to create a completely different environment.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Checking Slabs more thoroughly, you can expect to find parked trucks, burned-out tanks and cars, stacked gabions, cargo containers, live-fire training rooms, prefabricated multi-level buildings, concrete blocks, barriers, and walls, and a few tactically important doors you can shoot open, barge through or open slowly with stealth in mind. Construction markings, grenade marks, arrows, named labels for each Slab, training targets, named rooms (using duct tape floor markers), number markings, and a host of other scenic elements are there to assist in your spatial awareness as you learn the environments.[/p][p][/p][h3]Slab Configurations[/h3][p]Each set of three Slabs — a Combo — is rectangular in shape, and always the same footprint size (roughly that of the Modern Warfare (2019) map “Shoot House”). Every Slab is self-contained, but with the necessary openings to allow flow throughout the map to adjacent Slabs. Every match involves traversing all three of these slabs, which are connected along their longitudinal edges to form the entire Combo playspace.  Here’s how the two slab types differ:
[/p][p][b]End Slabs:[/b] There are always two End Slabs on each Kill Block match map, and each of them is one third of the play space and connects to each side of the Central Slab. Teams enter via an infil armory room and into their End Slab, with a perimeter wall gate closing behind them at the start of a match. End Slabs always have these gates (labeled A or B) on the outer wall, directly opposite the other, and in non-Gunfight modes, team members will spawn in and around the back portion of their End Slab.[/p][p][/p][p]After spawning, teams with tactical know-how usually move forwards towards the Central Slab with the safety off. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b6602a3a0726cb9845da6518235090ec7403a4b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Central Slabs:[/b] Linked on each side to an End Slab, the middle of the map offers scenery particularly crafted to enhance combat coming in from multiple angles, with a variety of commanding vantage points, chokepoints, and defensive positions. Teams can move freely between all three slabs.[/p][p][/p][h3]Environmental Challenges[/h3][p]Certain Slabs are fitted with military-grade weather simulation arrays along with powerful fans that propel vast quantities of misting water or snow across the slab’s entirety. With inclement conditions and the possibility of rain or snow flurries, Operators need to adapt to shifting visibility, altering sightlines, and other evolving tactical conditions. Expect weapons to also react to the weather, with ice particles or a wet sheen building up on the weapon until you swap armaments or reload.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aad547ba534f443ad01218286e366e618a79f374.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2aecd7f64b2c352862c0f9250fc16bb1c827dc92.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Before and after a snow flurry within the central Slab “Crash”.[/i][/p][h3][i]
[/i]Veteran Terrain[/h3][p]While most Slabs are entirely new, others recreate iconic locations including Crash from Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (2007), Storage Town from Call of Duty: Warzone’s Verdansk map and Shoot House from Modern Warfare (2019). Paired with different neighboring Slabs, these familiar spaces play in entirely new ways. Though drawn from iconic maps, these Slabs are fundamentally recontextualized by the randomized environments surrounding them, allowing familiar terrain to deliver both the classic moments you remember and entirely new tactical experiences.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block Map Situational Overview[/h3][p]Every Kill Block match is fought across a random selection of three Slabs bolted to each other. When this larger map in its entirety is measured, the entire area is roughly the same size as the Modern Warfare (2019) map “Shoot House”.
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/91733a5e3deb76ddd9d13ec02238d2fe0f765a06.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8b5ee3812ca42ae865eefe5408c609690513526.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Ensure your situational awareness by checking the perimeter walls so you know where you are. Note the “B4” and “B3” location wall markers in both wildly different Combos.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]For those needing more tactical awareness, the perimeter of the map has indications of smaller sections that serve as visual reference points, helping you identify your location more rapidly while you glance at the mini-map for red dots. Along the map’s longer north and south wall perimeter, there are six “A” and “B” sectors respectively, while the shorter east and west walls have two “C” and “D” sectors, each between an entrance gate where each team spawns. You’re able to tell where you are due to each perimeter section’s letter and number emblazoned at intervals around the map’s perimeter wall.[/p][p][/p][p]Use all this knowledge as you learn your Kill Block environments to pinpoint enemies over your comms and learn the maps you’re dropped into.[/p][p][/p][h2]“Safety Off Beyond This Point”: General Tactical Awareness[/h2][p][i]Learn. Adapt. Dominate.[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Know your terrain by studying each Slab's layout, movement options, and sightlines, then apply that knowledge in a changing mix of combat environments.
[/p][/*][/list][p]As you learn the layouts of the different slabs, you’re able to tactically piece together sightlines that carry across the entire Kill Block space itself. It’s worth remembering there are spray-painted signs branding a wall that names most slabs, as well as the names of each Slab appearing during the infil as the map reconfigures between matches, enabling you to quickly ascertain which slabs you’re playing on and learn their layouts the longer you play.
[/p][p]Furthermore, with Modern Warfare 4’s full suite of refined and fluid movement mechanics, expect to be able to scramble across Slab scenery with the same rapid dexterity as you would during a Core Multiplayer match. This includes vertical positioning: climbing onto rooftops, atop containers, onto upper balconies, and ascending to other areas that offer advantageous sightlines at the expense of exposure. Kill Block’s adaptive Multiplayer maps have been designed to offer tactical benefits and creative challenges no matter where you’re positioned.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block Slab Examples[/h3][p]The following examples and the video footage within this Blog highlight just a selection of the dozens of Slabs available at launch, each offering its own tactical opportunities and combat challenges. Note that the names of Slabs are subject to change prior to the game’s launch:
[/p][p][b]\[ Ambush ] // Central Slab:[/b] A slice of the classic Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare map, this training facsimile features a convoy-clogged main road with blown-out pre-fab buildings either side, with plenty of elevated sniper nests that look across the adjacent End Slabs. [/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ Blacksite ] // End Slab:[/b] Three prefabricated structures are positioned around the slab with open access between each of them, with mud and grass thoroughfare, a rusted van, open cargo container, and stacked military gabions as well as concrete barrier stacks to tactically maneuver between.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ Killhouse ] // End Slab:[/b] A section of the seminal Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare map, with a similar aesthetic, with gabions placed at corners of prefab walls, some with gaps to climb over, with a central kill box in the middle, and smaller scenic cover opportunities along the far edge of the Slab.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ ME-Town ] // Central Slab:[/b] A kill box dirt courtyard surrounded by four prefabricated structures, roughly in each corner, some with significant interior and roof top space available for long-range overwatch coverage. The main turquoise building is a warren of tight rooms and scramble points constructed with mobility training in mind.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ Snow Block ] // End Slab:[/b] A maze of stacked gabion walls of varying lengths, along with tactically positioned open cargo containers and other concrete blocks. Operators must weigh the benefits of overwatching from the top of these fortifications, as your line sights improve at the expense of cover.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ Trench ] // Central Slab:[/b] A no-man’s land of sunken mud walls and pill boxes with sandbags, tires, and wooden trusses keeping the dirt trenches from collapsing. The action is particularly fraught in the exposed middle with concrete barriers, and a burned tank offer a modicum of protection and sight lines.[/p][p][/p][h2]Kill Block: Live-Fire Gunfights[/h2][p][i]High-Stakes Team Combat[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Gunfight returns with 3v3 and the all-new 10v10 modes, where shared loadouts, single-life rounds, and decisive teamwork determine every victory.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]On October 23, Kill Block launches with expanded Gunfight experiences, featuring both 3v3 and the all-new Gunfight 10v10 modes. Every round pits teams against one another in fast-paced, single-life combat with every elimination carrying weight and every surviving teammate influencing a round outcome. Communicate effectively, capitalize on opportunities, and execute under pressure to claim victory.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e5c6b8e99ac1bcb8a12c6fa894a15486288bda2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each round begins with all Operators equipped with the same randomized Primary and Secondary Weapons, Tactical and Lethal Equipment, ensuring every player starts on equal footing. There are no custom Loadouts to rely on, placing the emphasis squarely on teamwork, weapon proficiency, and tactical decision making. If neither team is eliminated before the round timer expires, an Overtime Flag deploys into the combat zone, forcing both teams to converge on it. Capture this Flag to claim victory or fight to maintain the health advantage if time runs out.[/p][p][/p][p]During Kill Block Gunfight matches, teams swap sides after the first round. After the second round ends, the three Slabs change to a new Combo (map), a new random loadout is equipped, and the match continues. Combos continue to change every two rounds until one of the teams wins six rounds.[/p][p][/p][p]While Gunfight 3v3 and 10v10 headlines Kill Block at launch, the West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility has been engineered as a modular combat platform capable of supporting additional core Multiplayer modes in future post-launch seasons. Players can expect the facility's adaptive battlegrounds to provide fresh tactical challenges across an expanding variety of Multiplayer modes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Beyond Kill Block: The Complete Multiplayer Offering[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bac70e54847c575b42c8d0f5dde96f976fc6b6e0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]From the adaptive battlegrounds of Kill Block to the globe-spanning Core MP maps, large-scale Ground War battles, tactical one-life modes, fan-favorite respawn and round-based playlists, and Party Modes, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer is built for every possible engagement. Alongside Kill Block, players can look forward to: 
[/p][list][*][p]12 grounded Core multiplayer maps set across globally diverse locations, each built around distinct visual identities and tactical flow, with two additional favorites dropping just after launch.

Every Core map features its own custom insignia and visual branding inspired by the location, operation, or conflict surrounding the environment, from Lotus (a Korean fishing village in the aftermath of an amphibious assault) to Rooftops (the snow-lined rooftops of a New York Hotel) and Mumbai (a fugitive’s hideout inside a dense residential district).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Larger scale battles with armored vehicles across expansive maps, featuring brutally intense combined-arms warfare.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A full suite of Multiplayer Modes and Hardcore variants, from fan favorites like Team Deathmatch, Domination and Hardpoint to new modes with full reveals in the weeks to come.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Expect Party Modes to also arrive at launch, with additional modes coming shortly after release.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you prefer chasing the objective, coordinating with your squad, or simply racking up eliminations, there's a mode built to match your playstyle.[/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0cd59c7a91551190f88b01565f9100fe5faa2281.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay tuned to the Call of Duty Blog for the latest official Modern Warfare 4 intel as we move toward additional information drops before the Modern Warfare 4 launch on October 23.  Preorders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at CallofDuty.com. For more information on preordering, including Vault Edition content, rewards, and a special Loyalty Discount, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"]see the Preorder blog here[/url]. [/p][p][/p][h2]Development Credits[/h2][p]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026. [/p][p][/p][p]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Additional development by in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone - Season 05
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c19ba9d6ae099beab0b7a6da34a6cc405e53a2d1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Unleash the Arsenal: Black Ops Season 05[/u][/h2][p][/p][h3]Season 05 Roadmap[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cf500592871675ae7be988eb257ce0178bcc9537.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty® Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]™, Season 05 delivers a huge season of content. Multiplayer brings a hard-hitting lineup led by the brand-new Jubilee map, set in a rural town in Japan where the action never stops. In Zombies, rip through the undead in a new Survival map at launch and prepare to confront the Warden in the epic Mid-Season conclusion to the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies story. In Endgame, race against the clock in the new Burn Run Assignment and further enhance your Operator with Ability Boosts.[/p][p][/p][p]Plus, push the action even further with new events, Weekly Challenges, a brand-new Battle Pass, a serving of new weapons including the FG42 Assault Rifle, Gremlin SMG, and Mammoth LMG, and much more.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="kfDcQB6KPME;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Season 05 is armed and ready for action. Own the stage and get ready to fight when new free and premium content arrives in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] Season 05, launching on July 23 at 9AM PT across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Assignment:[/b] Take to the roads in a bomb-rigged vehicle in the new Burn Run Assignment, challenging Operators to a race against the clock while running over enemies and objects to add valuable seconds to the timer. Stick to the path, seek out bonuses en route, and don’t let up on that gas pedal.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Ability Boosts:[/b] Further customize your Operator with the addition of Ability Boosts, earnable primarily in Nightmare zones with a chance to drop in Zone IV. Ability Boosts add additional upgrades to your Major and Minor Abilities, from reducing their cooldown time to adding more ammo, inflicting additional damage types, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Free to Play Ends Soon:[/b] Season 05 is your last chance to jump into Endgame for free with your squad. Don’t miss out![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]New Assignment: Burn Run (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/264562cda695cf2248f3662e4f7aea86e2070438.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get pumped in Avalon with the new Burn Run Assignment, challenging Operators to a race against the clock in a bomb-rigged vehicle that’s ready to explode. As the music rages on, step on the gas and pass through all thirty arches, each one embroiled in flames so you know exactly where to go.[/p][p][/p][p]The pathway is littered with Fear enemies and objects; run them over to add additional seconds to the clock and seek out bonuses like repair wrenches and speed boosts to keep your vehicle in working order as you blast through the racecourse. Keep your eyes on the road, hit everything in your path, and get to the destination.[/p][p][/p][h3]Exotic Ability Boosts (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/24d90bd22eca3d5fcce2f4205fdef45381a5a828.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Upgrade your Major and Minor Abilities with new, rare enhancements that can be acquired in the match, further empowering them with advantages including reduced cooldown times, extra ammo, the chance to inflict additional damage types, and other bonuses improving their effectiveness in the field.[/p][p][/p][p]Found in item cases, Ability Boosts are mixed in with other reward types and are chosen based on your currently equipped Major and Minor Ability. Though Ability Boosts have a small chance to drop in Zone IV regions, they are primarily found in Nightmare locations. Open your Tac Map and check the rewards list of various Nightmare level Activities and Assignments to discover where you have the best chance of discovering them.[/p][p][/p][p]Each Major and Minor Ability has two Exotic Ability boosts to choose from. Once acquired, the Ability Boost will remain until you either wipe or swap out the affected Ability.[/p][p][/p][h2]Free to Play Throughout S05[/h2][p]Endgame’s free-to-play period is planned to continue through to the conclusion of Season 05, so be sure to jump in with your squad to explore all that Avalon has to offer in this expansive PvE mode. Once Season 06 of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] begins, Endgame will no longer be accessible via the [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] menu and will be available only to [i]Black Ops 7[/i] owners.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] Crash the party at a rural Japanese festival in the brand-new Jubilee map and deploy to remastered maps Dig and Frequency. In the Mid-Season, invade a Nuketown pinball machine in Turbo Tilt and jump, dive, and traverse a harrowing parkour environment with the arrival of a new Freerun map.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Power up your Operator while capturing and defending objectives in Overdrive Domination. In Gauntlet Rush, compete for the top spot across five different game modes, and in the Mid-Season, turn the adrenaline up to eleven in Cranked Moshpit. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, delivering new rewards to those who prove their worth in the rankings.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][/p][p]Jubilee (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f7f81a715e30fb2b5f3b80be9463098b00a378ef.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Fight through a rural Japanese town as a festival turns to chaos and the streets erupt in conflict. Battle in the front courtyard of the Palace museum, explore local cuisine in the pop-up Festival, and test your luck in the pachinko room offering low and standard rates. For a more scenic path, traverse the outer Garden running behind residential spaces above street level.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a99dc89176d1fdb93512fc8387c23b96173280f7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For long-ranged skirmishes, head down the central Main Street running down the length of the map where scattered vehicles provide some cover throughout. For tighter encounters, flank out to the sides where there’s a greater mix of sightlines, giving every playstyle a chance to shine in the celebratory scene.[/p][p][/p][p]Frequency (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/35f5630a44832bbf0fb5dd980d04a3e311612d35.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]First introduced in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Frequency returns fully remastered with greater detail than ever before. Deploy deep into the mountains of Hunan where Operators engage in constant battle over control of the listening station’s global surveillance capabilities.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/43aad05db1fc79898301981b47405b7842aa5cc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Take in the sights along the outer platform as you battle down the infamous Catwalk and Pipes sections on the perimeter, or head inside the facility for close-quarters action in the Surveillance room and amongst the Servers. The map opens up in the middle with skirmishes breaking out all around the circular pathway; drop down into the Maintenance area to travel below the path. Whatever your approach, make liberal use of the Wall Jump for new angles of attack while throwing off the enemy’s aim. newsitems.title: Warframe creative director says Destiny 2's end is tragic, because even with hard work 'the business side of this industry always gets the last remark'
newsitems.author: Harvey Randall
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 isn't going anywhere, but it also isn't… well, going anywhere. The game's servers will still be running for the foreseeable future, but Bungie has since ceased updates to its flagship shooter to move onto other projects, tragically laying off much of its staff in the aftermath of that decision... Read more.

newsitems.title: Destiny 2 players get a final farewell gift from Bungie
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 is done: The final patch is out, Bungie is decimated, and the game will remain playable but the story of one of the biggest, best and most influential online shooters ever is over. To memorialize the moment, Bungie has rolled out one last gift for players: A new emblem, free for everyone, called Gloriabundus... Read more.

newsitems.title: Former Destiny 2 and Marathon director settles $200 million lawsuit against Sony and Bungie: 'The outcome is one I am very satisfied with'
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: Former Destiny 2 and Marathon director Christopher Barrett has settled his lawsuit against Sony and Bungie. Terms of the settlement were not disclosed, but Barrett implied a favorable outcome, saying he's "very satisfied" with it... Read more.

newsitems.title: Dota 2's Dark Carnival has begun, with a huge story chapter and five automaton hero personas
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
At last, weeks of speculation and mystery can finally be put to bed: the Dota 2 Dark Carnival has begun. Valve's latest big event is here, and as many were hoping (myself included), it's a full-scale story campaign in a similar format to 2024's Crownfall. This time, the tale opens with Legion Commander and Hoodwink trapped on board a clanking circus train, imprisoned by the dastardly Ringmaster.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Dota 2's Dark Carnival has begun, with a huge story chapter and five automaton hero personas

newsitems.title: The Dark Carnival
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/7942925df6ae43659acf60f2d2ff827461c02485.png[/img]

Don't you hate it when you wake up in a prison car with no memory of how you got there and, worse, no way to escape, only to discover you've been captured by an evil puppet-man as part of some dark bargain with an ancient world-conquering evil? We've all been there.

We're pulling back the curtain on [url=http://dota2.com/darkcarnival]the Dark Carnival[/url], a new ongoing event in the Dota universe. This first part, "Midnight Run", lets you navigate Legion Commander and Hoodwink through a massive, fully-voiced Dota story featuring a spider-legged convoy of deadly robots, heartstopping secrets, and unique rewards.

Today's update features five all-new Automaton Personas (mechanical reimaginings of classic Dota heroes with new animations, effects, icons, and more), 20 new hero sets (some in a brand new treasure, and some that can only be earned by exploring the map and story), and much more. There's [url=http://dota2.com/darkcarnivalcomic]a comic[/url] if you're the kind of person who likes backstory.

But if, much like Legion Commander and Hoodwink themselves, you'd prefer to be thrown into the action without a lot of pesky memories of how you wound up in Ringmaster's prison train, the first stage of Midnight Run is now live in-game and free for all players. This is just the beginning: There are plenty of surprises in Midnight Run, and we're just getting started.
